notes: Ribbon is a client-side load balancer; it has no group coordinator, session, heartbeat to a broker, or service registration. The only liveness mechanism in these files is the client's own ping timer (BaseLoadBalancer.java lines 256-276) and the markServerDown entry points.

canSkipPing (BaseLoadBalancer.java lines 256-262) returns true when ping is null or DummyPing, so with the default NFLoadBalancerPingClassName no ping timer is created and no periodic liveness check runs.
NFLoadBalancerPingInterval has no default in CommonClientConfigKey.java line 161; the effective default is the 30 at BaseLoadBalancer.java line 172, applied when the key is unset.

NFLoadBalancerMaxTotalPingTime is stored by setMaxTotalPingTime (BaseLoadBalancer.java lines 342-347) and read back only by getMaxTotalPingTime (line 351). The Pinger and SerialPingStrategy (lines 650-927) do not read it, so it is not enforced in these files.

ServerListRefreshInterval (CommonClientConfigKey.java line 173), EnableMarkingServerDownOnReachingFailureLimit (line 175), ServerDownFailureLimit (line 177) and ServerDownStatWindowInMillis (line 179) are declared with no default in these files. Their consumers are not among the given files, so they are not reported as facts.

ShutdownEnabledTimer (BaseLoadBalancer.java line 273) is not vendored in these files. The thread behaviour is therefore not stated here, and the heartbeat-thread-independent fact rests only on the schedule call at line 275.

facts.subject: NFLoadBalancerPingClassName
facts.note: Default ping class. DummyPing disables the ping timer (BaseLoadBalancer.java lines 256-262). DefaultClientConfigImpl.java line 336 sets this key from getDefaultNfloadbalancerPingClassname (line 79-80).

facts.subject: NFLoadBalancerPingInterval
facts.note: Computed default: CommonClientConfigKey.java line 161 declares the key with no default, so this 30 applies when unset. The value is in seconds (setPingInterval, line 322). Applies only when the ping class is not DummyPing.

facts.subject: NFLoadBalancerMaxTotalPingTime
facts.note: Computed default: CommonClientConfigKey.java line 163 declares no default. The value is stored by setMaxTotalPingTime (lines 342-347) and not read by the pinger in these files.

facts.subject: ServerListUpdaterClassName
facts.note: Default server-list updater class, which polls for membership. Its interval key ServerListRefreshInterval (line 173) has no default stated in these files.

facts.subject: NFLoadBalancerPingInterval
facts.note: The client's own PingTask runs every pingIntervalSeconds and calls IPing.isAlive per server (BaseLoadBalancer.java line 912, token ping.isAlive(servers[i])). The broker, group coordinator, registry server and registry agent are not involved in these files. Detection is therefore by the client only, and only when the ping class is not DummyPing (lines 256-262).

facts.subject: BaseLoadBalancer.PingTask
facts.note: The periodic ping is scheduled on lbTimer, a timer named NFLoadBalancer-PingTimer- (line 273), not invoked from chooseServer. Caveat: forceQuickPing (lines 817-827) runs the Pinger synchronously on the caller's thread, and setServersList (line 543) calls it. Only the periodic path is independent. Only applies when the ping class is not DummyPing.

facts.subject: BaseLoadBalancer.Pinger
facts.note: Full text: "Server [{}] status changed to {}", logged at DEBUG level when a server's alive flag flips to DEAD (line 697, token ALIVE/DEAD).

facts.subject: BaseLoadBalancer.markServerDown(Server)

facts.subject: BaseLoadBalancer.markServerDown(String)
facts.note: Full text: "markServerDown called for server [{}]", logged at ERROR level, only when a server in upServerList was marked down.

facts.subject: BaseLoadBalancer
facts.note: Exposed @Monitor name, built as PREFIX + "UpServerList" with PREFIX = "LoadBalancer_" (line 67). Type INFORMATIONAL. The list is the live alive set that the pinger rebuilds (lines 705-707).

facts.subject: BaseLoadBalancer
facts.note: ServerStatusChangeListener callback, invoked with the changed servers by notifyServerStatusChangeListener (called from the pinger at line 709 and from markServerDown). The interface itself is not in these files.
